teaches: a sun letter carrying an observed shadda after the article completes the assimilation claim
a moon letter resolves as non-assimilating from membership alone; gemination there is structurally excluded
a following laam is a sun letter classified from the closed inventory like any other; it is not confused with, or specially treated because of, the article's own written laam

nun is a sun letter that learners often misfile as moon (mc-0477); with no observed shadda the table withholds the assimilation-completed claim rather than guessing from the (wrong) class or from the unvocalized surface
an observed shadda on a moon letter contradicts the closed sun/moon inventory; the table refuses it rather than explaining it away as assimilation (def-r3)
no declared article means the table is out of regime, regardless of how strong the following-letter and shadda evidence looks (def-r5)
missing shadda evidence is refused exactly like a declared absence, never defaulted to either reading
transfer: the sun-letter-plus-observed-shadda reasoning drilled on shin in def-pos-01 applies uniformly across the full fourteen-member sun set, here on taa
